card.name: Opening word of a dosing instruction
card.fires_on: The first word of an instruction or sentence in dosing text, such as 'a', 'one', 'Use' or 'Additional'. It comes right after verbs like prescribe, initiate or add, or at the start of a new sentence or section.

modes.label: Article after a prescribing verb
modes.description: The word 'a' follows prescribe, initiate with, or at, just before 'lower/low/5 mcg' dose wording.
modes.example: prescribe<< a>> lower initial dose of the opioid and tit

modes.label: Sentence-initial Use or Additional
modes.description: A new sentence or numbered section opens with 'Use' or 'Additional'.
modes.example: 5.11<< Additional>> Clinically Significant Adverse Reactions and

modes.label: Quantity in a step
modes.description: The number 'one' after 'Add' in preparation steps.
modes.example: 1. Add<< one>> tablespoon of applesauce to an empty bowl
